mechanism: Sertraline increases serotonergic activity which may potentiate levodopa's effects and increase risk of serotonin syndrome; carbidopa-levodopa may increase serotonin levels through monoamine pathways.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); consider dose adjustment of levodopa if symptoms emerge or efficacy changes.
